findings.summary: The git-backed landing check is inert until --repo-path is configured: FleetStateConfig.repo_path and the CLI --repo-path both default to None while DEFAULT_REPO_PATH is defined but not wired, so an unconfigured read-model degrades every terminal==complete development to 'unharvested' (false positives) until a repo path is supplied at deploy time. Non-blocking; refused/fault exclusion is unaffected.
